f95-hover-content-not-hoverable-pointer-: A tooltip or pop-up that appears on hover vanishes the moment you move the mouse toward it, so you can never reach it to read it.
applicability-author-vs-ua-title-tooltip: Telling apart a browser's built-in title= tooltip (which this rule ignores) from a custom one the developer built to look identical, since only the custom one has to follow the rules.
dismissible-esc-keyboard-dismiss-without: A hovered or focused pop-up covers other content but offers no key (like Escape) to clear it, forcing low-vision users to move the mouse and lose what they were reading.
dismissible-position-obscures-meaningful: A pop-up with no dismiss key sits on top of real content or controls rather than empty space, hiding information the user still needs.
persistent-auto-timeout-vs-valid-info-in: A hover or focus pop-up closes itself on a timer or a stray mouse move while the user is still reading it, instead of staying until they leave or dismiss it.
hover-content-no-keyboard-focus-trigger-: Useful content shows only when you hover with a mouse and never appears on keyboard focus, so keyboard-only users can never see information that mouse users get.
